rv.q: With new plays every week, The Infinite Wrench is the NY Neo-Futurists’ ongoing and ever-changing attempt to shift the conventions of live performance and speak to audiences including those unreached or unmoved by traditional theater.

The Infinite Wrench is a constantly evolving theatrical experiment in which the New York Neo-Futurists attempt to perform 30 short plays within the span of an hour. Each performance is different, drawing on original material crafted by the ensemble that can shift from comedic to serious, personal to political, absurd to poignant.
